product_details.care_instructions: Machine wash cold, hang dry, iron on medium heat

reviews.author: Sebastian Moore
reviews.comment: Absolutely stunning shirt. The linen is incredibly breathable and the mandarin collar gives it a refined, minimalist look. A wardrobe essential.

reviews.author: Julian Harte
reviews.comment: Best shirt I've bought this year. The vertical stripes are subtle yet elegant and it pairs with everything from chinos to shorts.

reviews.author: Freddie Armstrong
reviews.comment: Exceptional quality for the price, especially with the discount. The sage green is exactly as pictured and the drape is beautiful.

faqs.question: Does linen wrinkle easily?
faqs.answer: Linen naturally wrinkles but this adds to its relaxed, casual charm. A light iron on medium heat will smooth it out if preferred.

faqs.question: Is this shirt see-through?
faqs.answer: The fabric has a medium weave that is not fully opaque. Wearing a light undershirt is recommended in bright lighting.

faqs.question: Is the mandarin collar comfortable for all-day wear?
faqs.answer: Yes, the band collar sits close to the neck without being restrictive, making it comfortable even for extended wear.

reviews.author: Dylan Reed
reviews.comment: Love the bold Courage graphic. The burnt orange color is vibrant and rich and the relaxed fit is incredibly comfortable for all-day wear.

reviews.author: Mason Clark
reviews.comment: Really nice streetwear tee. The organic cotton feels noticeably softer than regular cotton and the print quality is excellent.

reviews.author: Tyler Hughes
reviews.comment: Great relaxed fit tee. The graphic hasn't cracked after multiple washes which is always a good sign. Would buy again.

faqs.question: Is the fabric environmentally friendly?
faqs.answer: Yes, this t-shirt is made from 100% organic cotton, grown without the use of synthetic pesticides or fertilizers.

faqs.question: Will the graphic peel or crack after washing?
faqs.answer: The graphic uses high-durability screen-print ink. Washing inside out in cold water will preserve the print quality over time.

faqs.question: How does the relaxed fit compare to a regular fit?
faqs.answer: The relaxed fit is wider through the chest and body, giving a casual, slightly oversized look compared to a standard regular fit.

reviews.author: George Phillips
reviews.comment: Comfortable enough shorts for summer. The loose fit is very breathable but they run slightly large so consider sizing down.

reviews.author: Finn Murphy
reviews.comment: Decent quality denim shorts. Nothing outstanding but they're perfectly fine for casual beach or weekend outings.

reviews.author: Oscar Bennett
reviews.comment: Average shorts. The Bermuda length is ideal but the denim feels a bit heavy for very hot weather. Good for mild summer days.

faqs.question: How long are the Bermuda shorts?
faqs.answer: These shorts fall just above the knee, which is the classic Bermuda length.

faqs.question: Do these shorts have pockets?
faqs.answer: Yes, they feature two front slash pockets and two back patch pockets.

faqs.question: Should I size up or down?
faqs.answer: These run slightly large. We recommend sizing down by one for a better fit around the waist.

product_details.care_instructions: Machine wash warm, tumble dry low

reviews.author: Caleb Jordan
reviews.comment: These are the best black jeans I've owned in years. The faded wash gives them an effortlessly cool, worn-in aesthetic.

reviews.author: Evan Price
reviews.comment: Slim, comfortable and very stylish. The stretch fabric makes them easy to wear all day without feeling restricted.

reviews.author: Aidan Ross
reviews.comment: Really happy with this purchase. The faded finish looks premium and they pair well with literally any top.

faqs.question: Will the faded effect wash out over time?
faqs.answer: The faded effect is a permanent fabric treatment designed to maintain its appearance with proper care.

faqs.question: Are these jeans suitable for smart-casual wear?
faqs.answer: Yes, pair them with a blazer and loafers for a polished smart-casual look, or keep it casual with a tee and sneakers.

faqs.question: Do these jeans have stretch?
faqs.answer: Yes, the 2% elastane blend provides a comfortable stretch while ensuring the jeans retain their shape over time.
